# Zaika Worlds

> Cook famous dishes from Pakistan and India, plus favourites from around the world, with big photos and step by step methods. 32 recipes in 13 languages: English, Roman Urdu, Hindi, Spanish, French, Arabic, Portuguese, Russian, Chinese, Japanese, German, Turkish and Bengali. Fifteen recipes also have a video in all 13 languages.

- [Zaika Worlds](https://www.zaikaworlds.com/): home page with all 32 recipes, search, categories and trending dishes
- [About](https://www.zaikaworlds.com/about): how the recipes are written
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.zaikaworlds.com/privacy): what this site does and does not collect
- [Contact](https://www.zaikaworlds.com/contact): write about a recipe, a correction, or a question about this site
- [Sitemap](https://www.zaikaworlds.com/sitemap.xml): all pages
- [RSS feed](https://www.zaikaworlds.com/feed.xml): all 32 recipes

## Recipes

- [Chicken Biryani](https://www.zaikaworlds.com/recipe/biryani) (Pakistan, 60 min): Biryani is not just food, it is a feast. Marinate the chicken in yoghurt and spices, boil the rice halfway, then put it on dum, masala below, rice on top, and the colour in between
- [Beef Nihari](https://www.zaikaworlds.com/recipe/nihari) (Pakistan, 90 min): Nihari is not fast food, it is food of patience. Cook the meat on low heat for hours, until it falls off the bone and the gravy takes on its deep colour and flavour.
- [Chicken Karahi](https://www.zaikaworlds.com/recipe/karahi) (Pakistan, 40 min): The secret of karahi is fresh tomatoes and high heat. No onion is needed, the tomato water itself becomes the masala, and ginger and green chillies at the end complete it.
- [Daal Fry (Tadka Daal)](https://www.zaikaworlds.com/recipe/daal) (India, 35 min): Daal is every home's daily food, but the tadka makes it special. Boil the daal until soft, then temper cumin, garlic and whole red chillies in ghee, the aroma alone is enough.
- [Chapli Kabab](https://www.zaikaworlds.com/recipe/chapli) (Pakistan, 30 min): Chapli kebab means flat, soft and spicy. Mix tomato, pomegranate seeds and whole spices into the mince, flatten it by hand, then fry both sides on a tawa.
- [Chicken Tikka](https://www.zaikaworlds.com/recipe/tikka) (Pakistan, 45 min): Good tikka comes from marination. Keep chicken in yoghurt, red chilli and garam masala for at least 1 hour, then grill on high heat, lightly charred outside, juicy inside.
- [Halwa Puri Nashta](https://www.zaikaworlds.com/recipe/halwapuri) (Pakistan, 50 min): Halwa puri is not breakfast, it is a tradition. Puffed puri, soft halwa and spiced chickpeas, the combination of all three is the soul of this breakfast.
- [Punjabi Samosa](https://www.zaikaworlds.com/recipe/samosa) (India, 45 min): A samosa lives in its crisp pastry and spiced potato. Knead the flour firm, mix garam masala and coriander into the potato, then fry on low heat, the pastry will be golden and cris
- [Bun Kebab](https://www.zaikaworlds.com/recipe/bunkebab) (Pakistan, 25 min): Bun kebab is Karachi's identity. Fry shami kebabs on a tawa, place them in a bun, add onion, tomato and tamarind chutney, every bite has the perfect balance of masala and chutney.
- [Gulab Jamun](https://www.zaikaworlds.com/recipe/gulabjamun) (India, 40 min): Gulab jamun turn soft when the khoya is good and the syrup is lightly warm. Fry the jamuns on low heat, then put them in syrup for 1 hour, they will drink the syrup and swell.
- [Gajar Ka Halwa](https://www.zaikaworlds.com/recipe/gajarhalwa) (India, 55 min): Gajar ka halwa needs patience. Cook the carrots in milk on low heat; when the milk dries, add ghee and sugar, and finish with khoya and almonds, the best winter aroma.
- [Mango Lassi](https://www.zaikaworlds.com/recipe/lassi) (India, 15 min): Mango lassi is summer's answer. Take ripe, sweet mangoes, add cold yoghurt and cardamom aroma, 1 minute in the blender, and comfort in a glass.
- [Margherita Pizza](https://www.zaikaworlds.com/recipe/pizza) (Italy, 75 min): Margherita pizza is proof that simple food can be extraordinary. It was made famous in Naples, where a hot oven, a thin crust, bright tomato sauce and good mozzarella do all the wo

## Notes

- Every recipe has ingredients with quantities, a step by step method, cooking time and servings.
- Recipe videos are added per recipe; 15 recipes have a video in all 13 languages and the rest are being added.
- Saved recipes are stored in the visitor's own browser (localStorage), not on this site.
